regions.today: Mostly cloudy today with outbreaks of rain and drizzle extending from the south, becoming patchier through the late afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 7 to 10 degrees in mostly moderate, occasionally fresh east to northeast winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight, rain and drizzle will gradually become confined to southern areas as dry conditions with clear spells extending from the north. Lowest temperatures of 4 to 9 degrees in mostly light to moderate northeasterly winds, fresher at times near coasts.
regions.tomorrow: Cloudy in southern parts tomorrow morning with patchy rain, drizzle and mist, slowly clearing southwards through the day. Elsewhere will be dry with a mix of cloud and sunny spells and just the chance of the odd stray shower. Highest temperatures of 8 to 11 degrees in light to moderate northeasterly winds, fresher at times near coasts.
